title: Adjust the line height of the recording studio instructions
goal: Makes the description text for both font sizes have a line height proportional to their respective font sizes.
summary: line-height determines the height of the text line box. When setting a number without units, the browser multiplies the number by the element's own font size.
tasks: sets line-height: 1.75 for two paragraphs of description with reading-copy class.
uses the existing 16px font size for the main description and the existing 12px font size for the small notes. A row during the open period will use the original row height.

example.note: extension number is 18px, each line is 27px high. When using this rule to create a small 14px pavilion, each line will be 21px high.

hint: When writing 28px directly, the two paragraphs of description will get the same line height. Write the value as 1.75 to allow small text to be calculated at its own font size.
